body.x: HANNOVER, Germany (AVING Special Report on 'CeBIT 2008') -- <Visual News> PQI will showcase its waterproof USB flash drive and overclocking module during CeBIT 2008 held in Hannover on March 4~9.
(Picture: PQI's waterproof USB flash drives supporting up to 4GB capacity)

Divided into three sections, the UFD display area focuses on Intelligent Stick derived products, a PQI self developed Ur-Smart personal file management software and a live overclocking module demo area for visitors to get a better understanding of PQI products.

The Intelligent Stick derived products, all made of special COB manufacturing process making them waterproof, dust-proof and revolutionary in USB flash drive design. Utilizing its unique interface design, derived products are fashionable in design and a breakthrough in UFD technology.
